crossRefs.note: Don’t rejoice when your enemy falls. Don’t let your heart be glad when he is overthrown,
“If you meet your enemy’s ox or his donkey going astray, you shall surely bring it back to him again.
If you see the donkey of him who hates you fallen down under his burden, don’t leave him. You shall surely help him…
But I tell you, love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who…
But a certain Samaritan, as he traveled, came where he was. When he saw him, he was moved with compassion,
Therefore “If your enemy is hungry, feed him. If he is thirsty, give him a drink; for in doing so, you will heap coals…
Don’t be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

translations.web: If your enemy is hungry, give him food to eat. If he is thirsty, give him water to drink;
translations.bsb: If your enemy is hungry, give him food to eat, and if he is thirsty, give him water to drink.
translations.kjv: If thine enemy be hungry, give him bread to eat; and if he be thirsty, give him water to drink:
translations.asv: If thine enemy be hungry, give him bread to eat; And if he be thirsty, give him water to drink:
